Disabling include_document_structure still produces content without the document tree overhead

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<article><h1>Heading</h1><p>Paragraph body.</p></article>', HtmlToMarkdownRs::ConversionOptions.new(include_document_structure: false))
puts result.inspect
```
